headline: Eliminated the site's largest layout-shift class via build-time SSR, then locked it with a blocking CLS-regression gate.

items.title: /changelog/ CLS 0.7332 -> 0.0006 via build-time SSR
items.insight: SSR the you-asked-shipped box at build from the committed ship-receipts feed (shared renderer + drift gate); client skips when present. The single-script bisect lied (compound/order-dependent shifts) so the fix was measured end-to-end.

items.title: intent-flight-director CLS: /universe/ 0.27 + /games/ 0.18 -> 0.0006
items.insight: SSR the Pathfinder panel into the 3 over-budget routes; client re-ranks the same 3 slots in place with personalization -> zero shift, local-first soul preserved. Homepage (0.037) untouched.

items.title: Blocking CLS-regression gate (8 routes @0.10)
items.insight: tests/cls-regression.spec.js wired into the e2e compliance job. Fix-then-gate: all routes measured green first. Structural prevention of the 1.03-accumulation class.

items.title: pathways-router uncaught error root-fixed on 5 public pages
items.insight: defer-vs-idle load race threw VSPublicIntel.get() undefined, aborting init; now renders base pathways immediately (intel is enrichment). Verified clean + 0.0006 CLS on all 5.

items.title: /membership/ interview mount CLS 0.1135 -> 0.0006
items.insight: Per-viewport reserved min-height (207/182px) for the deterministic static entry card; SSR reserved only where content is dynamic.

followUps: Homepage LCP critical-CSS split (genius #1) honest-deferred with evidence: element optimal (164ms local unthrottled), only lever is the FOUC-risky 47KB render-blocking inline-CSS split on the brand anchor; needs a dedicated throttled-Lighthouse before/after + multi-viewport FOUC pass. Floor NOT lowered (CANON-031).
Document the SSR + client-skip/hydrate convention so future post-paint widgets start zero-CLS.
/universe/ never loads public-intelligence.js (ambient when-clause excludes it) — pathways render base content there, enrichment silently absent.
blockers: Worker redeploy founder-gated: CF_WORKER_API_TOKEN lacks R2 Storage:Edit + User Details:Read + Memberships:Read (re-verified /user 403).
